name: MXL Switcher Core
description: Deterministic Program and Preview routing for MXL video flows. Processing, audio, monitoring, control surfaces, and encoded destinations remain separate media functions.
notes: Candidate contract for a locally built, versioned image. The mounted config must use /mxl-domain, reference definitions under /usr/local/share/mxl-switcher-core/acceptance or another mounted path, and bind the control listener to 0.0.0.0 when publishing port 18085. Keep the control API on a trusted network or behind an authenticated TLS reverse proxy.
